data.narrative:
Arxlight is a seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Sagar Patel and Paul White. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 comparables: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI.

The peer-median approach, the applicable triangulation method, examines three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables. UFORCE (Seed, $1.0B), Singularity (Series A, $400M), and NODA AI (Series A, $125M) establish a range spanning $125M to $1.0B, with a median of $400M. This peer-median method directly implies a $400M valuation for Arxlight.

The triangulated analysis, based on one method, supports a valuation range of $340M to $460M, with a median point of $400M. Key uncertainties include the limited sample size—only three direct comparables—and the stage mix within the peer set, where two comparables are Series A rather than pure seed. The substantial spread between low peer ($125M) and high peer ($1.0B) reflects heterogeneity in Defense & Security funding dynamics. Additional methodologies (revenue multiples, DCF, or broader market benchmarking) would strengthen conviction; however, available data permits only the peer-median approach at this time.
